release_notes: Promote the latest authoritative `main` lineage through `23adef9f67ae798a46e79733990b35d4357ba0e9` as FOODEX 1.0.94. Include the Customer mobile merchandising and finance presentation polish from #2261, including refreshed shopping/category/product presentation and customer-facing finance terminology. Include the ERP local/testing workspace activation fix from #2264 while preserving production deny-by-default behavior. Rebuild the Dashboard update, Laravel Setup, and Customer, Driver and Van Android artifacts from the same synchronized release source. Synchronize Customer, Driver and Van release identities at `1.0.94+94`; no prior APK is reused as the canonical 1.0.94 artifact. Keep the release package cumulative from the canonical updater boundary and preserve the production API endpoint `https://foodex.50sols.com`.
